programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Full Time
programs.feeNote: Provisional fee for PGDM / PGDM-FM / PGDM-Marketing / PGDM-BFS 2027-29: admission 50,000 + tuition 22,27,000 + lifetime alumni 8,000 + refundable caution deposit 15,000 = 23,00,000 (Year 1 13,00,000; Year 2 10,00,000). IMT states the programme fee covers tuition, boarding, lodging and academic materials.
programs.intakeNote: IMT Ghaziabad's NIRF 2026 data submission (hosted on web.imt.edu): sanctioned intake 510 for all 2-year PG programmes combined in 2024-25 (660 in 2023-24).
programs.placementNote: IMT Ghaziabad official placements page, final placement 2024-26: average CTC 17.64 LPA, median 16.50 LPA, highest domestic 35.00 LPA, highest international 46.17 LPA; 195 recruiters (86 new). Figures appear to cover all IMT Ghaziabad 2-year PGDM programmes combined; audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on CAT 2026 / XAT 2027 / GMAT and profile
selectionProcess.detail: IMT considers academic performance, competitive exam scores, work experience (if any), professional qualifications and overall profile. No special weightage for category. GMAT scores must reach IMT by 15 Jan 2027.

selectionProcess.name: Critical Thinking Test and Personal Interview (CTPI)
selectionProcess.detail: Offline CTPI from 8 January 2027 across 22 cities; slot booking first week of January 2027. Weights not published.

selectionProcess.name: Final results
selectionProcess.detail: Admission offers announced after completion of evaluation.

keyDates.notes: IMT Common Admissions 2027: Profile Detail Form opens end of October 2026; application deadline 27 Nov 2026; CTPI slot booking first week of Jan 2027; CTPI from 8 Jan 2027. Application fee Rs 3,500 + charges. Accepts CAT 2026, XAT 2027, GMAT (from 1 Jul 2022).
